location_model_notes: Explicitly scoped to entrance tunnel + relay stations + safehouse hub only, per Vol IV 8.2. The Core Gate and White Void are separate out-of-scope locations. Riggs' old laboratory (Mission 6) is also explicitly not this location.

structural_position.vertical_notes: Beneath even the Undercroft's living foundation. Dead, not derelict — a deliberate distinction.
structural_position.radial_notes: In-fiction: no coordinates, unmappable, by design. For production purposes only: deepest terminus of the old pre-Council transit network, beyond the Undercroft's outer-ring foundation belt and deeper than Metro Archives' sub-basement seam.

sub_locations.notes: Begins at the crackling energy field. Everything before this point is Undercroft/transit substrate scope, not this district.
Intentionally under-furnished. A safehouse, not a home.
Same physical space as dead_relay_stations, final evolutionary state, not a new separate location.

weave_coverage.note: The sole confirmed exception to universal Weave coverage among all locations documented so far. Absolute, not partial.

enforcement_doctrine.notes: Security model does not apply here. Safety is physical secrecy (single known access point), not technological invulnerability. This risk is deliberately left unresolved, per canon's own restraint.

npcs.notes: No background population of any kind. Population scarcity is a deliberate identity constraint, see Sec. 14 of Sector_0.md.

relay_fragment_lighting.description: Individual dead relay stations visibly reactivate as memory_fragment_count increases. No new collectible category. No change to TRANSCEND threshold math (KB Sec 5.2 untouched).

undercroft.detail: Shared old transit substrate. Sector 0 is what the Undercroft would be if it had died instead of survived.

white_zones.detail: Most monitored space vs. only unmonitored space; no meaningful connection beyond opposition.

metro_archives.detail: Metro Archives' sub-basement node is an early regional node; Sector 0 is the original core it was a smaller cousin of.

olympus_spire.detail: Sector 0 is what the Spire's primary server hub used to be before superseding it. Spire not redesigned by this document.

core_gate_and_white_void.detail: Separate locations per Vol IV asset list. Adjacent narratively via the Descent connective scene. Require their own design pass.

out_of_scope_flagged.reason: Mission 8 location, distinct per Vol IV 8.2. Requires own design pass.
Final Boss arena, distinct per Vol IV 8.2. Requires own design pass.
Explicitly NOT Sector 0 — an active VOID stronghold, opposite in character. Already flagged in Undercroft package.

technical_notes.streaming_priority_notes: Low NPC/combat density makes this cheap to stream. Priority QA should focus on the four lighting-state transitions rather than performance optimization.
